mapper.insert: INSERT INTO miniprograme.certification ( imageUrl, display,type, awardLevel, content, regionLevel, userName, awardName, personal, supplement, awardTime, organization,school,judgeRepeat,repeatId) VALUES (#{imageUrl}, #{display}, #{type}, #{awardLevel}, #{content}, #{regionLevel}, #{userName}, #{awardName}, #{personal}, #{supplement}, #{awardTime}, #{organization}, #{school},#{judgeRepeat},#{repeatId})
mapper.update: UPDATE miniprograme.certification SET imageUrl = #{imageUrl}, display = #{display}, type = #{type}, awardLevel = #{awardLevel}, content = #{content}, regionLevel = #{regionLevel}, userName = #{userName}, awardName = #{awardName}, personal = #{personal}, supplement = #{supplement}, awardTime = #{awardTime}, organization = #{organization} WHERE id = #{id}
